title: Incentre lattice
description:
This repository is an open research project around a geometric construction that begins with a square, its diagonals, and the incentre of each triangle.

It holds an interactive site, research notes with the code behind every number, and a preprint, version 3, not peer reviewed, on the bridged cross-polytope framework, including unit-spring elastic constants in every dimension n >= 3 and an exact motion from the CaB6 boron net to face-centred cubic packing.

Every claim on the ledger is labelled PROVEN, VERIFIED NUMERICALLY, CONJECTURE or KNOWN. Nothing here has been peer reviewed.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
